name: SPZ v4 Format Parsing
aliases: ZSTD streams in KMP splat parser
definition: A parser component capable of reading SPZ v4 format files, which utilize ZSTD compression streams.
summary: SPZ v4 Format Parsing decodes binary files into SplatCloud structures using per-attribute ZSTD compression, enabling web-compatible loading of high-fidelity 3D Gaussian splats without native system libraries.
